policy.restore_requires: unique maintained source authority, executable value, non-duplicative role, full upgrade route
policy.consolidate_requires: history retained; reusable source migrates through reviewed PR; no second runtime or publisher
policy.historical_requires: immutable evidence or reproducibility record; no active release path
policy.new_hugging_face_spaces: forbidden unless this contract and both front doors change together with measured provider need
